title: Get Node Neighbors
description: Extract the set of neighbors for the target node from the graph structure.

title: Count Possible Triangles
description: Calculate the maximum number of possible connections among neighbors: deg(v) * (deg(v) - 1) / 2

title: Count Actual Triangles
description: Count how many of those neighbor pairs are actually connected to each other (forming triangles with the target node).

title: Compute Ratio
description: Divide actual triangles by possible triangles to get the local clustering coefficient between 0 and 1.

title: Calculate Global Average (Optional)
description: Average all local clustering coefficients or compute the ratio of closed triplets to total triplets for the global measure.
